Method of Attack: Injected malicious code to open a crypto wallet popup on legitimate websites, prompting users to connect a Web3 wallet.
Impacted Systems: Websites embedding and playing Lottie animations or Lottie-based Telegram Sticker animations using the compromised versions.
Attack Vector: Compromised npmjs token used to publish malicious versions.
Indicators of Compromise: Crypto wallet popup on legitimate websites
Compromised versions served on CDNjs.com via explicit version specifier.
